claims: The Artemis II mission successfully launched from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Pad 39B on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II mission carried four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission was a 10-day mission around the moon.
Artemis II was the first crewed lunar flyby since 1972.
Official launches are streamed on the NASA YouTube Channel.
Launch Pad 39A is primarily used for SpaceX Crew Dragon and Falcon Heavy launches.
Launch Pad 39B is used for NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) and Artemis missions.
The Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex offers dedicated, ticketed viewing areas with live commentary.
